title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_12730)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard covers the requiremeats, tests and the guidance for coordination of internal fuses used to protect capacitors for inductive heat generating plants operating at frequencies between 40 Hz and 60 Hz in accordance with . 1.2 This standard also applies to internal overpressure disconnectors used to protect self-healing metallized dielectric capacitors. 1.3 This standard does not apply to fuses and disconnectors for which service conditions, in general, are incompatible with the requirements of this standard, unless otherwise agreed between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 1.4 The guidance for coordination of fuse and disconnector protection is given in Annex A.
